sloka: ततस्तस्माद्भयान्मुक्ताः कतिचित्तत्र राक्षसाः ।निहतान् किङ्करान् सर्वान् रावणाय न्यवेदयन् ।। ५.४२.४२।।।।
transliteration: tatastasmādbhayānmuktāḥ katicittatra rākṣasāḥ ।nihatān kiṅkarān sarvān rāvaṇāya nyavedayan ।। 5.42.42।।।।

translations.english: Then a few surviving ogres took to their heels after getting over that shock and reported to Ravana of the destruction of the kinkaras in the combat
